name: Sand control (gravel pack, frac pack, screens)
aliases: Sand control (gravel pack, frac pack, screens)
principle: Sand control keeps formation sand out of the well in soft reservoirs, typically with compressive strength below about 1,000 psi, using gravel packs, frac packs or screens; excluding sand builds a filter cake that can impair productivity, while managed sand production is sometimes cheaper and recovers more oil. PetroWiki's page covers the managed approach, not the mechanical methods.

process_steps.name: Place gravel pack or frac pack

source.note: PetroWiki (SPE), Sand control (page covers managed sand production; does not describe gravel pack)

limitations: Mechanical methods are not described in the page read
